binary_encoding: dtype-major f64,f32,flex32,f16,bf16, one Erf operation, ascending unsigned inputs; five destination-width LE words input/ideal/staged/allowed_low/allowed_high, then u32 intermediate_f32
closure: Every legally admitted stored intermediate input at each of three materialized Erf steps has an immutable reference. Unknown finite inputs fail.
metrics: Ideal and staged metrics use independent pair eligibility, matrices and worst witnesses. Half acceptance uses exact F32 neighbor image.
nan: Expected NaN is canonical class sentinel; every input/source NaN byte remains exact. Arbitrary chain NaN inputs use class-only fallback.

policy.dependencies: Burn Erf backward uses square, negate, exp and scalar arithmetic. Default GELU backward uses tanh approximation. Qualify separately.
policy.half_schedule: exact stored input -> exact F32 promotion -> F32 Erf -> one destination RNE
policy.legacy_f32: existing eight-step policy elsewhere stays unchanged until new execution proof and policy decision
policy.neighbor: exact RNE image of same-sign nonzero F32 neighbors inside [-1,1]
policy.normal_subnormal_boundary: diagnostic within numerical allowance, zero/nonzero remains strict
policy.oracle: MPFR 4.2.2 directed RNDD/RNDU at exact dyadic inputs, exact rational RNE; precision cap 16384
policy.scope: forward Erf only, no autodiff, GELU, GPU, full Burn, or performance claim
policy.status: project qualification targets, not vendor guarantees
policy.vendor_context: NVIDIA lists observed 2 ULP for erf and erff and explicitly does not guarantee its nonexhaustive bounds.
